sentences.en: Parents must look after the well-being of the their children.
sentences.zh: 父母必须照顾孩子的福祉。

sentences.en: Exercise is critical to many people's physical and mental well-being.
sentences.zh: 锻炼对许多人的身心健康至关重要。

sentences.en: She was concerned about the well-being of her brothers.
sentences.zh: 她很担心哥哥们的安危。

mnemonic: 合成词：well（好，健康）+being（存在）→安宁，福利
